verdict.rationale: Munito AI's public docs include a model catalog listing each model with its price for each service tier, so prices appear self-serve, with no sales contact required. The evidence does not confirm the pricing unit is per-token, and there are no concrete figures or independent corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit per-token (input/output) pricing units, actual price figures, confirmation that no model requires contacting sales, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see public per-token prices for every hosted model without talking to sales

citations.quote: Each model with its context, its regions and its price for each service tier.
